articles.title: Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.06919v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. articles.title: Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers
articles.summary: arXiv:2610.06928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence.
